manifesto.caption:
Tusenbruk begins after the wanting.

Portraits of people, seen through the things they use. Craft matters. Use is the proof.

Earn the wear.

#Tusenbruk #ObjectsInUse
slides: Portraits of people, seen through the things they use.
The scratch. The repair. The irritation that stays because the rest still works.

posts.hook: One link on the bracelet has a screw that backs itself out every few months. He tightens it. It loosens again. They have an understanding.

posts.hook: The heater takes fifteen minutes to mean anything in a Katoomba winter.
posts.caption:
The heater takes fifteen minutes to mean anything in a Katoomba winter. The turning circle requires planning. The brown shadow in the wheel arches has stopped responding to persuasion.

posts.hook: The sign says Diplomatic cars only. Beneath it is a Series III with its windscreen folded flat.
posts.caption:
The sign says Diplomatic cars only. Beneath it is a Series III with its windscreen folded flat. Nobody moves it on.

One Sunday in May, Belgrave Square belonged to Land Rovers. The Series III left last.
